nameOrigin: set of creatures including snails, whelks and slugs
of great size/importance; lord or master

pokedexEntries.di: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

pokedexEntries.prl: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

pokedexEntries.pt: Long ago, its entire back was shielded with a sturdy shell. There are traces of it left in its cells.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.
